content:
The HWPX generation failed because the output XML did not contain the expected formatted string combining birthdate and age.
The test 'test_required_values_present_and_repeated_value_updated' failed with an AssertionError in /tests/test_outputs.py. Specifically, the verifier expected the string '1990-11-02 (35세)' to be present in 'section0.xml', but it was missing from the generated HWPX section content. While basic patient name mapping worked, the logic for calculating or formatting the age suffix within the XML tags failed to match the required template output.
